findings.summary: The gate-file `check_entry` is a second, hand-written copy of the spec rules, alongside the hestia test that runs the real rule.
findings.evidence: The plan already proves the real behaviour with the hestia test, which calls `spec_gaps` and `measure_problem` (hestia.rs:1219-1308). `check_entry` restates some of those rules ('none' check, `status:` ending, one `status:`). It also adds a string check of its own (the measure must contain `bootstrap`). These copies can drift from the production rule without anything failing. Fix: Keep `check_entry` limited to what the hestia test does not check: the mechanism names `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range` and the measure names the tests. In a comment, call `spec_gaps` the authoritative gap rule, so later readers do not take the copy as the source of truth.

findings.summary: The brief lists crates/athena-gate/Cargo.toml as a file to modify, but the plan leaves it untouched.
findings.evidence: Expected deliverables include 'crates/athena-gate/Cargo.toml (modify)'. Criterion 5 says Cargo.toml is untouched, and Cargo.toml:16 and :20 already list serde and toml. Fix: Say in the PR description that this deliverable is deliberately left out because every dependency the test needs is already listed, so the verifier does not count it as missing.

findings.summary: `git init -q -b main` needs git 2.28 or later.
findings.evidence: The existing in-source tests create repositories through the `owner_repo()` and `repo()` helpers (invariant.rs:892, gate/src/lib.rs:396-418). The new test runs `git init` itself. Fix: Copy the exact init call the in-source helper uses, so both test paths need the same git version.

summary: I read the snapshot to check the plan; I ran nothing. Everything the plan names exists as it says. The OLY-B-O1-01 entry is at docs/spec.toml:2163-2169, with mechanism "none" and the measure "The spec gap list; status: requirement". `bootstrap_range` is public (invariant.rs:68, and lib.rs:18 has `pub mod invariant`). The existing rule-M6 test is at invariant.rs:1102-1122, and its refusal assert is at line 1121. `parse_spec`, `measure_problem`, `spec_gaps` and the `no_mechanism` field are in hestia.rs, and the plan's new test copies the model at hestia.rs:4315-4334. `toml`, `serde`, `tempfile` and `athena-git` are normal dependencies of athena-gate (Cargo.toml:11-20), and serde's derive is already used in the crate (secrets.rs), so Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock really can stay unchanged. `Git::isolated` sets the git identity and turns off commit signing (athena-git/src/lib.rs:179-196). The shard-timings line at 59 and the precedent at line 53 are as cited, and shard-timings.txt is the only file outside the test itself that lists test units. The xtask spec check (spec.rs:194-213) needs only a trailing `status: <label>`. Criterion 2 is properly shown to fail without the change: the hestia test runs the production gap rule on the real spec, and the gate-file checker is shown to reject the base entry. Criterion 3 honestly rests on the existing M6 test. The dependents list covers the readers I found. Athena's two scope findings are explained adequately in the plan. Only minor points remain.
